title: Refuse DynAdjust installation when licence acknowledgement checkbox is unchecked
scenario: Verifies that installing DynAdjust without ticking ACKNOWLEDGE_LICENCE raises a clear error.
expected_summary: Refuses installation with a clear message asking to acknowledge DynAdjust's licence.

verification.exception: Tick “I understand that DynAdjust is a separate program under its own licence” to install DynAdjust. It is a separate program by Geoscience Australia, under the Apache-2.0 licence (https://github.com/GeoscienceAustralia/DynAdjust), downloaded from their release page; GeoComp does not distribute it. Nothing was downloaded.
